slides.sub: Expansion, mentorship, and the network doing more work than you expect.

slides.body: Doors open faster than you built them. Opportunities arrive through people, not just effort — mentors, introductions, and expansion that outpaces your own plan.

points: Saying yes to every opportunity at once
Over-expanding before the Saturn-built base can hold it

slides.body: Use Jupiter's expansion on the foundation Saturn already built — not instead of it. This is the fundraising-and-scale phase, not the survive-on-hustle phase.
